nodes.name: expect_block
nodes.body_text: def expect_block(sql, args, kind): global failed try: connection.execute(sql, args) except sqlite3.IntegrityError as error: if not str(error).startswith(kind + " constraint failed"): raise AssertionError(f"Expected {kind} constraint failure, got: {error}") from error failed += 1 else: raise AssertionError("Cross-tenant or invalid write unexpectedly succeeded")

nodes.body_text: #!/usr/bin/env node // Strictly offline, conservative private-source migration preflight. // Default stdout has aggregate counts only; never echo a sermon title or raw row. import { createHash } from 'node:crypto'; import { readFile, writeFile, realpath } from 'node:fs/promises'; import { resolve, sep, dirname, basename } from 'node:path'; import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url'; // RFC-4180-style CSV reader. Handles quoted commas, newlines, escaped quotes, // CRLF and blank rows. Rejects an unfinished quoted field rather than guessing. if (process.argv[1] && fileURLToPath(import.meta.url) === resolve(process.argv[1])) { main(process.argv.slice(2)).catch(err => { console.error('Import preflight failed: ' + (err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'unknown error')); process.exitCode = 1; }); }

function parseCsv(text) { if (text.charCodeAt(0) === 0xfeff) text = text.slice(1); const rows = []; let row = [], field = '', quote = false; for (let i = 0; i < text.length; i++) { const ch = text[i]; if (quote) { if (ch === '"' && text[i + 1] === '"') { field += '"'; i++; } else if (ch === '"') { quote = false; const next = text[i + 1]; if (next !== undefined && next !== ',' && next !== '' && next !== '
') { throw new Error('Unexpected character after closing quote in CSV field'); } } else field += ch; } else if (ch === '"') { if (field !== '') throw new Error('Unexpected quote in CSV field'); quote = true; } else if (ch === ',') { row.push(field); field = ''; } else if (ch === '
' || ch === '') { if (ch === '' && text[i + 1] === '
') i++; row.push(field); rows.push(row); row = []; field = ''; } else field += ch; } if (quote) throw new Error('Unterminated quoted CSV field'); if (field !== '' || row.length) { row.push(field); rows.push(row); } return rows; }

nodes.name: normalizeDate
nodes.body_text: function normalizeDate(input) { const raw = String(input ?? '').trim(); const match = /^(\d{1,2})\/(\d{1,2})\/(\d{4})$/.exec(raw); if (!match) return { date: null, flags: ['invalid_or_missing_date'] }; const month = Number(match[1]), day = Number(match[2]), year = Number(match[3]); const valid = year >= 1900 && year <= 2100 && month >= 1 && month <= 12 && day >= 1 && day <= new Date(Date.UTC(year, month, 0)).getUTCDate(); if (!valid) return { date: null, flags: ['invalid_or_missing_date'] }; return { date: year + '-' + String(month).padStart(2, '0') + '-' + String(day).padStart(2, '0'), flags: day === 1 ? ['first_day_precision_review'] : [] }; }

nodes.name: titleKey
nodes.body_text: function titleKey(title) { return String(title ?? '').normalize('NFKC').trim().replace(/\s+/g, ' ').toLowerCase(); }

nodes.name: inspectHistory
nodes.body_text: function inspectHistory(csvText, options = {}) { const tab = options.tab || 'All History'; if (tab !== 'All History') throw new Error('Only canonical All History is accepted for the first import'); const csv = parseCsv(csvText); if (!/^date preached$/i.test(String(csv[0]?.[0] ?? '').trim()) || !/^sermon title$/i.test(String(csv[0]?.[1] ?? '').trim())) { throw new Error('Unexpected source headers; use the canonical All History export'); } const fingerprint = sha256(csvText); const rows = [], titleKeys = new Set(), placeNames = new Set(), keySet = new Set(); const flagCounts = {}; let duplicateCandidates = 0; for (let i = 1; i < csv.length; i++) { const values = Array.from({ length: 6 }, (_, c) => String(csv[i][c] ?? '')); if (!values.some(x => x.trim())) continue; if (/^please insert rows below this row/i.test(values[0])) continue; const date = normalizeDate(values[0]); const title = values[1].trim(), venue = values[5].trim(); const flags = ['ownership_unverified', ...date.flags]; if (!title) flags.push('missing_title'); if (!venue) flags.push('missing_place'); if (!values[2].trim()) flags.push('missing_category'); if (!values[3].trim()) flags.push('missing_tags'); for (const flag of flags) flagCounts[flag] = (flagCounts[flag] || 0) + 1; if (title) titleKeys.add(titleKey(title)); if (venue) placeNames.add(venue); const signature = [date.date || values[0], titleKey(title), venue.toLowerCase()].join('|'); if (keySet.has(signature)) duplicateCandidates++; keySet.add(signature); const sourceRow = i + 1; rows.push({ id: sha256([fingerprint, tab, sourceRow, JSON.stringify(values)].join(':')), source_tab: tab, source_row: sourceRow, raw: values, proposed_date: date.date, proposed_title: title || null, proposed_place: venue || null, flags, owner_workspace_id: null, review_status: 'unreviewed' }); } return { summary: { source_tab: tab, rows: rows.length, complete_date_title: rows.filter(r => r.proposed_date && r.proposed_title).length, unique_title_spellings: titleKeys.size, venue_variants: placeNames.size, exact_duplicate_candidates: duplicateCandidates, flag_counts: flagCounts, source_sha256: fingerprint, ownership_assigned: 0 }, rows }; }

nodes.name: preflightFile
nodes.body_text: async function preflightFile(input, tab = 'All History') { const stat = await readFile(input); if (stat.byteLength > 10 * 1024 * 1024) throw new Error('Source exceeds 10 MiB safety limit'); return inspectHistory(stat.toString('utf8'), { tab }); }

nodes.name: parseArgs
nodes.body_text: function parseArgs(argv) { const out = {}; for (let i = 0; i < argv.length; i++) { const key = argv[i]; if (!['--input','--tab','--private-output'].includes(key) || !argv[i + 1]) { throw new Error('Usage: --input /private/history.csv [--tab "All History"] [--private-output /private/review.json]'); } out[key.slice(2)] = argv[++i]; } if (!out.input) throw new Error('Missing --input'); return out; }

nodes.name: main
nodes.body_text: async function main(argv) { const args = parseArgs(argv); const result = await preflightFile(args.input, args.tab || 'All History'); if (args['private-output']) { const path = resolve(args['private-output']); const repo = resolve(fileURLToPath(new URL('..', import.meta.url))); const parent = await realpath(dirname(path)); const canonicalOutput = resolve(parent, basename(path)); if (canonicalOutput === repo || canonicalOutput.startsWith(repo + sep)) { throw new Error('Refusing to write private review data inside the public source repository'); } await writeFile(canonicalOutput, JSON.stringify(result, null, 2), { mode: 0o600, flag: 'wx' }); } // Avoid source titles, venues, row contents, and source paths in logs. console.log(JSON.stringify({ ...result.summary, source_sha256: result.summary.source_sha256.slice(0, 12) }, null, 2)); return result.summary; }

nodes.name: staging-qa.mjs
nodes.body_text: #!/usr/bin/env node /** * Staging end-to-end auth QA. Run with `pnpm qa:staging`. * * - Seeds synthetic `*.test` accounts, workspaces, sessions and invitations in the * STAGING D1 only (`wrangler d1 execute --env staging --remote`). * - Session and invite tokens are minted by inserting only their SHA-256 hashes * (the scheme in src/auth). Raw tokens live in memory and are never printed. * - Exercises the deployed Worker over real HTTP, prints a PASS/FAIL/SKIP table, * exits non-zero on any FAIL and removes every synthetic row it created. * - The real Google round trip (login, /api/me, logout) is out of scope: only the * /auth/google/start redirect and state replay rejection are covered here. */ import { execFile, spawn } from 'node:child_process'; import { createHash, randomBytes, randomUUID } from 'node:crypto'; import { readFile } from 'node:fs/promises'; import { join } from 'node:path'; import { promisify } from 'node:util'; const run = promisify(execFile); const ROOT = new URL('..', import.meta.url).pathname; const WRANGLER = join(ROOT, 'node_modules', '.bin', 'wrangler'); const ORIGIN = (process.env.STAGING_ORIGIN || 'https://sermons-preview.favor.church').replace(/\/$/, ''); const HOST = new URL(ORIGIN).host; const DOH = process.env.QA_DOH_URL || 'https://1.1.1.1/dns-query'; const SESSION_COOKIE = '__Host-sb_session'; const FLOW_COOKIE = '__Secure-sb_flow'; const EMAIL_DOMAIN = 'sermon-qa.test'; const RUN = randomBytes(3).toString('hex'); const results = []; const secrets = new Set(); // raw tokens and synthetic emails: must never appear in errors or logs const observedErrors = []; // every non-2xx response (status, headers, body) for the leak scan // ---------- HTTP (curl with DNS-over-HTTPS: local DNS can hold a stale negative cache) ---------- // ---------- D1 (staging only) ---------- // ---------- cleanup of every synthetic row (also removes leftovers from a crashed earlier run) ---------- let ownerTriggers = []; const SYN_ACCOUNTS = `(SELECT id FROM user_accounts WHERE email_normalized LIKE '%@${EMAIL_DOMAIN}')`; const SYN_WORKSPACES = `(SELECT id FROM workspaces WHERE owner_account_id IN ${SYN_ACCOUNTS})`; // Staging holds a real pilot workspace ("Favor Church") and pilot-qa.test accounts. This script may only touch // rows reachable from the sermon-qa.test domain, and aborts before any write if that boundary is crossed. const PROTECTED_WORKSPACE = 'Favor Church'; // ---------- fixtures ---------- const W = { alpha: uuid(), beta: uuid() }; const A = Object.fromEntries(['owner', 'admin', 'admin2', 'editor', 'viewer', 'outsider', 'invitee', 'inviteeWrong', 'expired', 'revoked', 'disabled', 'fresh'] .map(name => [name, { id: uuid(), email: email(name), session: token() }])); const INVITE_EXPIRED = { id: uuid(), raw: token() }; const INVITE_REVOKED = { id: uuid(), raw: token() }; const SERMON = { alpha: uuid(), beta: uuid() }; const OAUTH = { state: token(), nonce: token(), verifier: 'qa-' + token() }; for (const a of Object.values(A)) { secrets.add(a.email); secrets.add(a.session); } for (const t of [INVITE_EXPIRED.raw, INVITE_REVOKED.raw, OAUTH.state]) secrets.add(t); // ---------- QA items ---------- let startConfigured = false; // ---------- leak scan ---------- // ---------- main ---------- main().catch(error => { console.error('staging-qa aborted: ' + redact(error.message)); process.exit(2); });

nodes.body_text:
async function http(method, path, { cookie, headers = {}, body, origin = ORIGIN, json = true } = {}) { const args = ['-sS', '-i', '--max-time', '30', '--max-redirs', '0', '--doh-url', DOH, '-X', method]; const h = { ...headers }; if (cookie) h.cookie = cookie; if (method !== 'GET' && origin) h.origin = origin; if (body !== undefined) { if (json) h['content-type'] = 'application/json'; } for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(h)) args.push('-H', `${k}: ${v}`); if (body !== undefined) args.push('--data-binary', typeof body === 'string' ? body : JSON.stringify(body)); args.push(ORIGIN + path); let stdout; for (let attempt = 1; ; attempt++) { // retry transient network errors (DoH lookup, reset) only; HTTP statuses are never retried try { ({ stdout } = await run('curl', args, { maxBuffer: 4 << 20 })); break; } catch (error) { if (attempt >= 3) throw new Error(`curl failed (exit ${error.code}) ${method} ${path}: ${redact(String(error.stderr || '').trim().split('
').pop())}`); await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 1000 * attempt)); } } const split = stdout.indexOf('

'); const head = stdout.slice(0, split).split('
'); const status = Number(head[0].split(' ')[1]); const resHeaders = new Map(); const setCookies = []; for (const line of head.slice(1)) { const i = line.indexOf(':'); if (i < 0) continue; const k = line.slice(0, i).trim().toLowerCase(), v = line.slice(i + 1).trim(); if (k === 'set-cookie') setCookies.push(v); resHeaders.set(k, v); } const text = stdout.slice(split + 4); let data = null; try { data = JSON.parse(text); } catch { /* not JSON */ } const entry = { status, headers: head.join('
'), text, expected: [] }; if (status < 200 || status >= 300) observedErrors.push(entry); return { status, headers: resHeaders, setCookies, text, data, entry }; }

nodes.name: guardProtectedData
nodes.body_text: async function guardProtectedData() { if (EMAIL_DOMAIN !== 'sermon-qa.test') throw new Error('guard: QA email domain must be sermon-qa.test'); const [g] = await d1Rows(`SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM workspaces WHERE id IN ${SYN_WORKSPACES} AND name = ${q(PROTECTED_WORKSPACE)}) AS named, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM workspace_memberships WHERE workspace_id IN ${SYN_WORKSPACES} AND account_id NOT IN ${SYN_ACCOUNTS}) AS foreign_members, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM workspace_memberships WHERE account_id IN ${SYN_ACCOUNTS} AND workspace_id NOT IN ${SYN_WORKSPACES}) AS joined_elsewhere`); if (g.named || g.foreign_members || g.joined_elsewhere) { throw new Error(`guard: synthetic rows touch non-QA data (named ${g.named}, foreign members ${g.foreign_members}, joined elsewhere ${g.joined_elsewhere}); aborting without writes`); } }

nodes.name: cleanup
nodes.body_text: async function cleanup({ requireTriggers = false } = {}) { await guardProtectedData(); // The owner-protection triggers (correctly) block deleting owner memberships, so they are dropped and // recreated from the migration inside the same execution, then verified. const statements = [ `DELETE FROM oauth_login_attempts WHERE code_verifier LIKE 'qa-${'%'}'`, `DELETE FROM auth_sessions WHERE account_id IN ${SYN_ACCOUNTS}`, `DELETE FROM audit_events WHERE workspace_id IN ${SYN_WORKSPACES} OR actor_account_id IN ${SYN_ACCOUNTS}`, `DELETE FROM workspace_invitations WHERE workspace_id IN ${SYN_WORKSPACES} OR email_normalized LIKE '%@${EMAIL_DOMAIN}'`, `DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS protect_owner_membership_update`, `DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS protect_owner_membership_delete`, `DELETE FROM workspace_memberships WHERE workspace_id IN ${SYN_WORKSPACES} OR account_id IN ${SYN_ACCOUNTS}`, `DELETE FROM sermons WHERE workspace_id IN ${SYN_WORKSPACES}`, `DELETE FROM workspaces WHERE owner_account_id IN ${SYN_ACCOUNTS} AND name <> ${q(PROTECTED_WORKSPACE)}`, `DELETE FROM google_identities WHERE account_id IN ${SYN_ACCOUNTS}`, `DELETE FROM user_accounts WHERE email_normalized LIKE '%@${EMAIL_DOMAIN}'`, ...ownerTriggers ]; await d1(statements.join(';\n') + ';'); const left = await d1Rows(`SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_accounts WHERE email_normalized LIKE '%@${EMAIL_DOMAIN}') AS accounts, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sqlite_master WHERE name LIKE 'protect_owner_membership_%') AS triggers, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM oauth_login_attempts WHERE code_verifier LIKE 'qa-%') AS attempts`); if (requireTriggers && left[0].triggers !== 2) { throw new Error(`ABORT: staging D1 has ${left[0].triggers} owner-protection triggers after cleanup (expected 2); restore them from migrations/0002_auth.sql before any further run`); } return left[0]; }

nodes.body_text: function seedSql() { const t = now(); const s = []; for (const a of Object.values(A)) { s.push(`INSERT INTO user_accounts(id,email_normalized,display_name,disabled_at) VALUES(${q(a.id)},${q(a.email)},'QA Account',${a === A.disabled ? 'CURRENT_TIMESTAMP' : 'NULL'})`); } s.push(`INSERT INTO workspaces(id,name,owner_account_id) VALUES(${q(W.alpha)},'QA Alpha ${RUN}',${q(A.owner.id)})`); s.push(`INSERT INTO workspaces(id,name,owner_account_id) VALUES(${q(W.beta)},'QA Beta ${RUN}',${q(A.outsider.id)})`); const members = [[W.alpha, A.owner, 'owner'], [W.alpha, A.admin, 'admin'], [W.alpha, A.admin2, 'admin'], [W.alpha, A.editor, 'editor'], [W.alpha, A.viewer, 'viewer'], [W.beta, A.outsider, 'owner']]; for (const [w, a, role] of members) { s.push(`INSERT INTO workspace_memberships(workspace_id,account_id,role,accepted_at) VALUES(${q(w)},${q(a.id)},${q(role)},CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)`); } s.push(`INSERT INTO sermons(id,workspace_id,title) VALUES(${q(SERMON.alpha)},${q(W.alpha)},'QA alpha sermon ${RUN}')`); s.push(`INSERT INTO sermons(id,workspace_id,title) VALUES(${q(SERMON.beta)},${q(W.beta)},'QA beta sermon ${RUN}')`); for (const a of Object.values(A)) { const expires = a === A.expired ? t - 60 : t + 3600; const revoked = a === A.revoked ? 'CURRENT_TIMESTAMP' : 'NULL'; s.push(`INSERT INTO auth_sessions(token_hash,account_id,expires_at,revoked_at) VALUES(${q(sha256(a.session))},${q(a.id)},${expires},${revoked})`); } // Pre-existing invitations that must be refused: expired and revoked. s.push(`INSERT INTO workspace_invitations(id,workspace_id,email_normalized,invited_role,token_hash,invited_by_account_id,expires_at) VALUES(${q(INVITE_EXPIRED.id)},${q(W.alpha)},${q(A.fresh.email)},'viewer',${q(sha256(INVITE_EXPIRED.raw))},${q(A.owner.id)},${t - 60})`); s.push(`INSERT INTO workspace_invitations(id,workspace_id,email_normalized,invited_role,token_hash,invited_by_account_id,expires_at,revoked_at) VALUES(${q(INVITE_REVOKED.id)},${q(W.alpha)},${q(A.fresh.email)},'viewer',${q(sha256(INVITE_REVOKED.raw))},${q(A.owner.id)},${t + 3600},CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)`); // A login attempt for the state replay check (hash only; raw state is the callback parameter). s.push(`INSERT INTO oauth_login_attempts(state_hash,nonce,code_verifier,expires_at) VALUES(${q(sha256(OAUTH.state))},${q(OAUTH.nonce)},${q(OAUTH.verifier)},${t + 600})`); return s.join(';\n') + ';'; }

`${FLOW_COOKIE}=${cookieState}` : undefined }); const noCookie = await cb(OAUTH.state, null); check('OAUTH-2', 'Callback without flow cookie is rejected (401 login_failed)', noCookie.status === 401 && noCookie.data?.error === 'login_failed', `status ${noCookie.status}`); const mismatch = await cb(OAUTH.state, token()); check('OAUTH-3', 'Callback with state != flow cookie is rejected', mismatch.status === 401, `status ${mismatch.status}`); const unknownState = token(); secrets.add(unknownState); const unknown = await cb(unknownState, unknownState); check('OAUTH-4', 'Callback with never-issued state is rejected', unknown.status === 401, `status ${unknown.status}`); const malformed = await cb('short', 'short'); check('OAUTH-5', 'Callback with malformed state is rejected', malformed.status === 401, `status ${malformed.status}`); const before = await d1Rows(`SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM oauth_login_attempts WHERE state_hash = ${q(sha256(OAUTH.state))}`); check('OAUTH-6', 'Failed callbacks above did not consume the seeded attempt', before[0]?.n === 1, 'attempt row missing'); const first = await cb(OAUTH.state, OAUTH.state); check('OAUTH-7', 'Callback with valid state but bad code never creates a session (401)', first.status === 401 && !first.setCookies.some(c => c.startsWith(SESSION_COOKIE + '=') && !/Max-Age=0/.test(c)), `status ${first.status}`); const replay = await cb(OAUTH.state, OAUTH.state); check('OAUTH-8', 'Replayed state is rejected (401)', replay.status === 401, `status ${replay.status}`); if (startConfigured) { const after = await d1Rows(`SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM oauth_login_attempts WHERE state_hash = ${q(sha256(OAUTH.state))}`); check('OAUTH-9', 'State is single-use: attempt row deleted by the first callback', after[0]?.n === 0, 'attempt row still present'); } else { skip('OAUTH-9', 'State is single-use: attempt row deleted by first callback', 'needs Google secrets (callback is rejected before the attempt is consumed while unconfigured)'); } }

function scanForLeaks(label, { headers, text: body, expected = [] }) { const hits = []; const exempt = line => /^(location|set-cookie):/i.test(line) ? expected.reduce((l, s) => l.split(s).join(''), line) : line; const text = headers.split('
').map(exempt).join('
') + '
' + body; for (const s of secrets) if (text.includes(s)) hits.push('a known token/email'); if (/( at\s+\S+\s+\(|\.(ts|js|mjs):\d+| stack |D1_ERROR|SQLITE_|Error:)/i.test(text)) hits.push('stack/error internals'); if (/ (client_secret|GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET|PILOT_OWNER_EMAILS) /.test(text)) hits.push('secret name'); if (/[\w.+-]+@[\w-]+(\.[\w-]+)+/.test(text)) hits.push('an email address'); return hits.length ? `${label}: ${[...new Set(hits)].join(', ')}` : null; }

AND disabled_at IS NULL`).bind(identity.email).first<Account>(); if (byEmail) { const other = await env.DB.prepare(`SELECT subject FROM google_identities WHERE account_id = ?`) .bind(byEmail.id).first<{ subject: string }>(); if (other) return null; // Never link a different Google subject automatically. await env.DB.prepare(`INSERT INTO google_identities(subject, account_id) VALUES(?, ?)`) .bind(identity.subject, byEmail.id).run(); return byEmail; } const accountId = crypto.randomUUID(); await env.DB.batch([ env.DB.prepare(`INSERT INTO user_accounts(id, email_normalized, display_name) VALUES (?, ?, ?)`).bind(accountId, identity.email, identity.displayName), env.DB.prepare(`INSERT INTO google_identities(subject, account_id) VALUES(?, ?)`) .bind(identity.subject, accountId) ]); return { id: accountId, email_normalized: identity.email, display_name: identity.displayName }; }

AND expires_at > ? RETURNING nonce, code_verifier`) .bind(await sha256(state), NOW()).first<{ nonce: string; code_verifier: string }>(); if (!attempt) return reject(401); try { const idToken = await exchangeCode(code, attempt.code_verifier, c); const identity = await verifyGoogleIdToken(idToken, c.clientId, attempt.nonce); const account = await findOrProvisionAccount(env, identity); if (!account) return reject(403); const rawSession = randomToken(); await env.DB.prepare(`INSERT INTO auth_sessions(token_hash, account_id, expires_at) VALUES(?, ?, ?)`).bind(await sha256(rawSession), account.id, NOW() + SESSION_SECONDS).run(); const response = redirect('/welcome', sessionCookie(rawSession, SESSION_SECONDS)); response.headers.append('set-cookie', clearFlowCookie()); return response; } catch { // Never echo OAuth tokens, callback params or Google errors to a user/log. return reject(401); } }

AND wm.revoked_at IS NULL LIMIT 1`) .bind(workspaceId, email).first<{ found: number }>(); if (already) return reply(409, { error: 'member_exists' }); const rate = await env.DB.prepare(`SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM workspace_invitations WHERE workspace_id = ? AND created_at > datetime('now','-1 day')`).bind(workspaceId).first<{ n: number }>(); if ((rate?.n || 0) >= 20) return reply(429, { error: 'invite_limit_reached' }); const inviteId = crypto.randomUUID(), rawToken = randomToken(); await env.DB.batch([ env.DB.prepare(`INSERT INTO workspace_invitations (id, workspace_id, email_normalized, invited_role, token_hash, invited_by_account_id, expires_at) VALUES(?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)`) .bind(inviteId, workspaceId, email, role, await sha256(rawToken), actor.id, NOW() + INVITE_SECONDS), env.DB.prepare(`INSERT INTO audit_events(id, workspace_id, actor_account_id, action, target_type, target_id) VALUES(?, ?, ?, 'invitation.create', 'invitation', ?)`) .bind(crypto.randomUUID(), workspaceId, actor.id, inviteId) ]); // Email transport and web acceptance form are deliberately separate follow-ups. // The secret is returned once to an authorized Owner/Admin; never logged. return reply(201, { invitation_id: inviteId, role, email, token: rawToken, expires_in_seconds: INVITE_SECONDS, acceptance_endpoint: origin + '/api/invitations/accept' }); }

AND i.accepted_at IS NULL AND i.revoked_at IS NULL AND w.deleted_at IS NULL`) .bind(tokenHash, account.email_normalized, NOW()).first<InviteRow>(); if (!invitation) return reply(404, { error: 'invitation_not_available' }); const active = await membership(env, invitation.workspace_id, account.id); if (active) return reply(409, { error: 'already_a_member' }); const attempt = crypto.randomUUID(); const result = await env.DB.batch([ env.DB.prepare(`UPDATE workspace_invitations SET accepted_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, accepted_by_account_id = ?, acceptance_attempt_id = ? WHERE id = ? AND token_hash = ? AND accepted_at IS NULL AND revoked_at IS NULL AND expires_at > ?`) .bind(account.id, attempt, invitation.id, tokenHash, NOW()), env.DB.prepare(`UPDATE workspace_memberships SET role = ?, accepted_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, revoked_at = NULL WHERE workspace_id = ? AND acceptance_attempt_id = ?)`) .bind(invitation.invited_role, invitation.workspace_id, account.id, invitation.id, attempt), env.DB.prepare(`INSERT OR IGNORE INTO workspace_memberships(workspace_id, account_id, role, accepted_at) SELECT workspace_id, ?, invited_role, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM workspace_invitations WHERE id = ? if (request.method === 'POST' && pathname === '/auth/logout') return await logout(request, env, origin); if (request.method === 'GET' && pathname === '/welcome') return redirect('/api/me'); if (!pathname.startsWith('/api/')) return reply(404, { error: 'not_found' }); if (!access) return reply(404, { error: 'not_found' }); if (match[2] === 'sermons' && !match[3] && request.method === 'GET') return await listSermons(env, workspaceId); if (match[2] === 'invitations' && !match[3] && request.method === 'POST') { if (!can(access.role, 'invite')) return reply(403, { error: 'forbidden' }); return await inviteMember(request, env, workspaceId, actor, access.role, origin); } if (match[2] === 'members' && match[3] && request.method === 'PATCH') { if (!can(access.role, 'invite')) return reply(403, { error: 'forbidden' }); return await manageMember(request, env, workspaceId, match[3], actor, access.role); } return reply(404, { error: 'not_found' }); } catch { // Do not log private query values, credentials, emails, tokens, source paths, // or SQL text. No Google access tokens are persisted. */ import { base64url, fromBase64url, sha256 } from './security.ts'; const GOOGLE_JWKS_URL = 'https://www.googleapis.com/oauth2/v3/certs'; let keyCache: { until: number; keys: GoogleKey[] } | null = null;

nodes.body_text: function googleAuthorizationUrl(clientId: string, redirectUri: string, state: string, nonce: string, challenge: string): string { const url = new URL('https://accounts.google.com/o/oauth2/v2/auth'); url.search = new URLSearchParams({ client_id: clientId, redirect_uri: redirectUri, response_type: 'code', scope: 'openid email profile', code_challenge_method: 'S256', code_challenge: challenge, nonce, state, access_type: 'online' }).toString(); return url.toString(); }

nodes.name: googleKeys
nodes.body_text: async function googleKeys(): Promise<GoogleKey[]> { if (keyCache && Date.now() < keyCache.until) return keyCache.keys; const response = await fetch(GOOGLE_JWKS_URL, { signal: AbortSignal.timeout(6000), cache: 'no-store' }); if (!response.ok) throw new Error('Google public keys unavailable'); const text = await response.text(); if (text.length > 100000) throw new Error('Unexpected Google JWKS size'); const data: unknown = JSON.parse(text); if (!data || typeof data !== 'object' || !('keys' in data) || !Array.isArray(data.keys)) throw new Error('Invalid Google JWKS'); const keys = data.keys as GoogleKey[]; if (keys.length < 1 || keys.length > 100) throw new Error('Invalid Google JWKS count'); const seconds = Number(response.headers.get('cache-control')?.match(/max-age=(\d+)/)?.[1] || 300); keyCache = { keys, until: Date.now() + Math.min(Math.max(60, seconds), 3600) * 1000 }; return keys; }

nodes.name: verifyGoogleIdToken
nodes.signature: async function verifyGoogleIdToken( jwt: string, clientId: string, nonce: string, suppliedKeys?: GoogleKey[], nowSeconds = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000) ): Promise<GoogleIdentity>
nodes.body_text: async function verifyGoogleIdToken( jwt: string, clientId: string, nonce: string, suppliedKeys?: GoogleKey[], nowSeconds = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000) ): Promise<GoogleIdentity> { if (!jwt || jwt.length > 32000 || jwt.split('.').length !== 3) throw new Error('Invalid token'); const segments = jwt.split('.'); const header = JSON.parse(new TextDecoder().decode(fromBase64url(segments[0]))) as { alg?: unknown; kid?: unknown; typ?: unknown }; if (header.alg !== 'RS256' || typeof header.kid !== 'string' || !header.kid || (header.typ !== undefined && header.typ !== 'JWT')) throw new Error('Invalid token header'); const keys = suppliedKeys || await googleKeys(); const key = keys.find(k => k.kid === header.kid && k.kty === 'RSA' && (k.use === undefined || k.use === 'sig') && (k.alg === undefined || k.alg === 'RS256')); if (!key) throw new Error('Unknown signing key'); const publicKey = await crypto.subtle.importKey('jwk', key, { name: 'RSASSA-PKCS1-v1_5', hash: 'SHA-256' }, false, ['verify']); const message = new TextEncoder().encode(segments[0] + '.' + segments[1]); const signature = fromBase64url(segments[2]); if (!(await crypto.subtle.verify('RSASSA-PKCS1-v1_5', publicKey, signature, message))) throw new Error('Invalid signature'); const payload: unknown = JSON.parse(new TextDecoder().decode(fromBase64url(segments[1]))); if (!payload || typeof payload !== 'object') throw new Error('Invalid claims'); const claims = payload as Record<string, unknown>; if (claims.iss !== 'https://accounts.google.com' && claims.iss !== 'accounts.google.com') throw new Error('Invalid issuer'); if (claims.aud !== clientId || (claims.azp !== undefined && claims.azp !== clientId)) throw new Error('Invalid audience'); if (claims.nonce !== nonce) throw new Error('Invalid nonce'); if (typeof claims.exp !== 'number' || claims.exp <= nowSeconds - 30 || typeof claims.iat !== 'number' || claims.iat > nowSeconds + 30 || claims.iat < nowSeconds - 7200) throw new Error('Expired or invalid token'); if (claims.email_verified !== true && claims.email_verified !== 'true') throw new Error('Unverified email'); if (typeof claims.email !== 'string' || !/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(claims.email) || typeof claims.sub !== 'string' || claims.sub.length < 1 || claims.sub.length > 250) throw new Error('Invalid identity'); return { subject: claims.sub, email: claims.email.trim().toLowerCase(), displayName: typeof claims.name === 'string' && claims.name.length <= 120 ? claims.name : claims.email.split('@')[0] }; }

nodes.body_text: /** Reusable, auditable authorization and cookie rules. All app routes also check D1. */ export const SESSION_COOKIE = '__Host-sb_session'; export const FLOW_COOKIE = '__Secure-sb_flow';

nodes.name: Operation
nodes.body_text: type Operation = 'read' | 'edit' | 'invite' | 'manage_admin' | 'consent' | 'export' | 'delete' | 'transfer';

nodes.name: isRole
nodes.signature: function isRole(value: unknown): value is Role
nodes.body_text: function isRole(value: unknown): value is Role { return value === 'owner' || value === 'admin' || value === 'editor' || value === 'viewer'; }

nodes.name: can
nodes.signature: function can(role: Role, operation: Operation): boolean
nodes.body_text: function can(role: Role, operation: Operation): boolean { if (operation === 'read') return true; if (operation === 'edit') return role !== 'viewer'; if (operation === 'invite') return role === 'owner' || role === 'admin'; return role === 'owner'; }

nodes.name: canInvite
nodes.signature: function canInvite(actor: Role, desired: unknown): desired is Role
nodes.body_text: function canInvite(actor: Role, desired: unknown): desired is Role { return isRole(desired) && desired !== 'owner' && can(actor, 'invite') && (actor === 'owner' || desired === 'editor' || desired === 'viewer'); }

nodes.name: canManageMember
nodes.signature: function canManageMember(actor: Role, existing: Role, next: Role | 'revoke'): boolean
nodes.body_text: function canManageMember(actor: Role, existing: Role, next: Role | 'revoke'): boolean { if (existing === 'owner' || !can(actor, 'invite')) return false; if (actor === 'admin' && existing === 'admin') return false; if (next === 'revoke') return true; return canInvite(actor, next); }

nodes.name: randomToken
nodes.body_text: function randomToken(bytes = 32): string { const random = crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(bytes)); return base64url(random); }

nodes.name: base64url
nodes.body_text: function base64url(bytes: Uint8Array): string { let binary = ''; for (const byte of bytes) binary += String.fromCharCode(byte); return btoa(binary).replace(/\+/g, '-').replace(/\//g, '_').replace(/=+$/g, ''); }

nodes.name: fromBase64url
nodes.body_text: function fromBase64url(text: string): Uint8Array { if (!/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$/.test(text) || text.length > 50000) throw new Error('invalid encoding'); const encoded = text.replace(/-/g, '+').replace(/_/g, '/'); const decoded = atob(encoded + '='.repeat((4 - encoded.length % 4) % 4)); return Uint8Array.from(decoded, c => c.charCodeAt(0)); }

nodes.name: sha256
nodes.body_text: async function sha256(text: string): Promise<string> { return base64url(new Uint8Array(await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', new TextEncoder().encode(text)))); }

nodes.name: constantTimeEqual
nodes.signature: function constantTimeEqual(a: string, b: string): boolean
nodes.body_text: function constantTimeEqual(a: string, b: string): boolean { const aa = new TextEncoder().encode(a), bb = new TextEncoder().encode(b); let difference = aa.length ^ bb.length; for (let i = 0; i < Math.max(aa.length, bb.length); i++) difference |= (aa[i] || 0) ^ (bb[i] || 0); return difference === 0; }

nodes.name: getCookie
nodes.signature: function getCookie(request: Request, name: string): string | null
nodes.body_text: function getCookie(request: Request, name: string): string | null { let result: string | null = null; const header = request.headers.get('cookie') || ''; if (header.length > 8192) return null; for (const item of header.split(';')) { const part = item.trim(); const i = part.indexOf('='); if (i <= 0 || part.slice(0, i) !== name) continue; if (result !== null) return null; // duplicate cookie name => ambiguous request result = part.slice(i + 1); } return result; }

nodes.name: sessionCookie
nodes.body_text: function sessionCookie(token: string, seconds = 60 * 60 * 24 * 7): string { return `${SESSION_COOKIE}=${token}; Path=/; Max-Age=${seconds}; Secure; HttpOnly; SameSite=Lax`; }

nodes.name: clearSessionCookie
nodes.body_text: function clearSessionCookie(): string { return `${SESSION_COOKIE}=; Path=/; Max-Age=0; Secure; HttpOnly; SameSite=Lax`; }

nodes.name: flowCookie
nodes.body_text: function flowCookie(token: string, seconds = 600): string { return `${FLOW_COOKIE}=${token}; Path=/auth/google/callback; Max-Age=${seconds}; Secure; HttpOnly; SameSite=Lax`; }

nodes.name: clearFlowCookie
nodes.body_text: function clearFlowCookie(): string { return `${FLOW_COOKIE}=; Path=/auth/google/callback; Max-Age=0; Secure; HttpOnly; SameSite=Lax`; }

nodes.name: noStoreHeaders
nodes.body_text: function noStoreHeaders(): Headers { return new Headers({ 'cache-control': 'no-store, private', 'content-type': 'application/json; charset=utf-8', 'x-content-type-options': 'nosniff', 'referrer-policy': 'no-referrer', 'x-frame-options': 'DENY', 'vary': 'Cookie' }); }

nodes.name: reply
nodes.signature: function reply(status: number, body: Record<string, unknown>): Response
nodes.body_text: function reply(status: number, body: Record<string, unknown>): Response { return new Response(JSON.stringify(body), { status, headers: noStoreHeaders() }); }

nodes.name: publicOrigin
nodes.body_text: function publicOrigin(env: unknown): string | null { const val = readBinding(env, 'PUBLIC_ORIGIN'); if (!val) return null; try { const url = new URL(val); if (url.protocol !== 'https:' || url.pathname !== '/' || url.search || url.hash || url.username || url.password) return null; return url.origin; } catch { return null; } }

nodes.name: readBinding
nodes.signature: function readBinding(env: unknown, key: string): string | null
nodes.body_text: function readBinding(env: unknown, key: string): string | null { if (!env || typeof env !== 'object') return null; const value: unknown = Reflect.get(env, key); return typeof value === 'string' && value.trim() ? value.trim() : null; }

nodes.name: requiresSameOrigin
nodes.signature: function requiresSameOrigin(request: Request, origin: string): boolean
nodes.body_text: function requiresSameOrigin(request: Request, origin: string): boolean { const header = request.headers.get('origin'); const site = request.headers.get('sec-fetch-site'); return header === origin && (site === null || site === 'same-origin' || site === 'none'); }

nodes.name: parseEmail
nodes.body_text: function parseEmail(raw: unknown): string | null { if (typeof raw !== 'string') return null; const email = raw.trim().toLowerCase(); if (email.length > 254 || !/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(email)) return null; return email; }

nodes.name: readJson
nodes.signature: async function readJson(request: Request): Promise<Record<string, unknown> | null>
nodes.body_text: async function readJson(request: Request): Promise<Record<string, unknown> | null> { if (!request.headers.get('content-type')?.toLowerCase().startsWith('application/json')) return null; const length = request.headers.get('content-length'); if (length && Number(length) > 8192) return null; try { const text = await request.text(); if (text.length > 8192) return null; const result: unknown = JSON.parse(text); return result !== null && typeof result === 'object' && !Array.isArray(result) ? result as Record<string, unknown> : null; } catch { return null; } }

nodes.name: sign
nodes.body_text: async function sign(claims={},header={}){ const h=base64url(new TextEncoder().encode(JSON.stringify({alg:'RS256',kid:jwk.kid,typ:'JWT',...header}))); const p=base64url(new TextEncoder().encode(JSON.stringify({iss:'https://accounts.google.com',aud:clientId,iat:now,exp:now+3600,sub:'test-subject-1',email:'Pastor@Example.org',email_verified:true,nonce,...claims}))); const msg=h+'.'+p; const signature=await crypto.subtle.sign('RSASSA-PKCS1-v1_5',privateKey,new TextEncoder().encode(msg)); return msg+'.'+base64url(new Uint8Array(signature)); }
